Locus Aspect (Serpent Slumbering Beneath the Island)

question: With Habsburg Monarchy (Livestock Colony) Level 5 (Wave of Immigration), do you do the effect before or after the Explore on that turn?
answer:
After completely resolving the Explore Card above it, but before resolving the Adversary's "After the Explore Step" Escalation. If you're resolving another Explore Card that turn, e.g., because you're playing the Surges of Colonization scenario, resolve the effects of the Reminder Card before revealing the next Explore Card. Similarly, the effects of the Reminder Card happen before anything triggered by Advancing the Invader Cards, like the extra Build Step caused by the "Fortification" Event.
Formally, Reminder Cards resolve once you're done resolving the Invader Card above them. (Or, in unusual cases like this FAQ, if they end up atop the Invader Deck.)
This ruling originally implied that the "Seek Prime Territory" Escalation happens first. Because the timing of the Escalation was made more explicit in later printings, this ruling has been updated accordingly.

question: With Ocean's Hungry Grasp, what does it mean that "Oceans are treated as Coastal Wetlands for Blight" *(in addition to powers)*?
answer: You can place Blight in the Oceans as part of a cascade if you like.

question: With Pour Time Sideways and Dream of the Untouched Land could you use "skip actions on one board" on the "extra time" board (the board that Fractured Days' moved presence to)?
answer:
Yes. Dream of the Untouched land skips all Build Cards and "Each land"/"Each board" Adversary actions on one board, even if that board has had Time poured to it.
If this proves horribly abusive it'll be revisited, but that doesn't seem likely, it's pretty niche.
tags: Pour Time Sideways (Fractured Days Split the Sky)

question: With Powers Long Forgotten, when do you check whether a land is searched? Can a land be searched in the middle of a Power?
answer:
Yes, since the scenario says "whenever". For instance, if Call to Migrate gathers 3 Dahan to land A, then pushes the 3 Dahan to land B, both lands A and B are searched.
The Invaders will similarly search in the middle of an action.

question: With Promising Farmland, can you choose to add the Town in a land that wouldn't be explored anyway *(e.g., due to Wilds)*?
answer:
No.
You have to add a Town instead of an Explorer that would actually be placed. You can only avoid the Town if no Explorers would actually be placed on a board.

question: With Settle into Hunting Grounds, can your Presence count as both Badlands and Beasts for the same action? (e.g., if an Event does Damage per Beasts)
answer:
Yes.
It can also count as just one or the other.

question: With Shifting Memory of Ages and the Elemental Invocation scenario, are the Element Markers considered to be in the adjacent lands for the purposes of Observe the Ever-Changing World?
answer: No - they're not in the land, they're on a corner between lands.
tags: Observe the Ever-Changing World (Shifting Memory of Ages)

question: With Spirits that choose more than 1 Growth option, can I see the results of one choice before picking the next?
answer: Yes — you can completely finish resolving your first Growth choice before making your second choice.

question: With Spirits that get to choose multiple Growth options, if more than one option has "Gain Power Card", can I gain a Power Card *then* pick which Growth choice I was using?
answer: No. You choose a set of things to do, then do them all. If you have multiple Growth choices, you then do this again, and cannot choose one you already picked this turn.

question: With Sweep into the Sea, can you push Invaders into the Ocean on a board where Ocean's Hungry Grasp has presence?
answer:
Yes, absolutely.
If the Invaders are in a Coastal land, with Sweep into the Sea you can choose to either push them into the nearest Ocean (which is right there) or destroy them; with Ocean's Hungry Grasp in play, it will usually be better to push and Drown them.

question: With Terror Turns to Madness, if Fear from it gets you to the next Terror Level, do you also get the next Terror Level's effects?
answer: No, it's a 3-way conditional: you only check the Terror Level at the time you reach the first of the lines.

question: With the "Blitz" scenario, can you use the Energy gained from playing an already-Fast 0-cost Power Card to help pay for another Power Card?
answer: Yes. The intent is that already-Fast 0-cost cards effectively cost "negative 1 energy".

question: With the Aid the Uprising part of the Slave Rebellion Event card against Kingdom of France, is damage calculated against each Invader with Strife separately?
answer:
Yes, each individual Invader with Strife takes damage according to how many Dahan are present.
Thus, for instance, two Dahan can destroy any number of Towns with Strife.

question: With the aspect Wind for Lightning's Swift Strike, can you choose later which Power to make fast?
answer: Yes, you can choose at any point in the turn (usually during the Fast phase).

question: With the Dahan event Rouse the Spirits, when do you check if you meet the condition *(3+ Dahan in your lands)*? Can another Spirit help you meet the condition?
answer:
No, you check which Spirits meet the condition first, and then resolve the Powers.
The general rule is that when the game tells you "For each [thing that meets conditions], do [some action]", you first note which things meet the conditions, and then do the action on each of those things (in an order of your choosing). That is, the actions don't change which things met the conditions.

question: With the Despicable Theft Scenario, can you use Isolate to stop or detour Thieves?
answer:
Yes.
If you use Isolate to make the shortest path to a board’s Ocean longer than usual without completely blocking a Thief in, it will attempt that longer journey, even if that puts it onto another board. (In that case, on future turns it’ll head towards that board’s Ocean.)

question: With the Event Outpaced, do you need to pay for a card from Aid from Lesser Spirits?
answer:
No, you cannot pay for it to be sped up, nor can you discard it for Energy.
It is "used as if played", but is not a card you played.

question: With the Fear card Overseas Trade Seems Safer at Terror level 2, what happens if a City would be built in a Coastal land?
answer:
Nothing is built: no City, and also no Town.
If a Town would normally be built, it is built as normal.

question: With the growth of A Spread of Rampant Green, can I gain a power card and then choose where to use the first (non-optional) growth option?
answer:
Yes, you can choose where to place your Jungle/Wetlands presence based on a power card you gain that turn.
This is more explicit in the Branch & Claw rulebook, where there are more spirits with multiple growth choices.

question: With the Second Wave Scenario, how do you handle Still-Healthy Island cards?
answer:
The short version is "rewind cards, and what you learned doesn't change" (you'll use the same cards next game).
The long version: If you went past a Still-Healthy Island Card, after following the Blight instructions, put it – original Healthy side up – atop the stack of Blight Cards (so you encounter it first, just like you did this game).
If you reached (but did not pass) a Still-Healthy Island Card, treat it as a Blighted Island Card for the Blight instructions – but in your next game, if you get past it to a new Blight Card, you will need to add new Blight from the box rather than from the pool by the side of the card.
(If this is too complex, you may also opt to simply omit Still-Healthy Island cards.)

question: With the Ward the Shores scenario, how does Dances Up Earthquakes' Impending ability interact with playing Power Cards face-down to make Warding Patterns?
answer:
Dances Up Earthquakes may Impend a Power Card face-down; this counts as its "once per turn" face-down play. (The next turn, it will come into play, but not count as its "once per turn" face-down play.) Once a card is Impended face-up, it cannot later be flipped face-down. 
A strict reading of the rules would likely result in the opposite timing, but would be a lot weirder/less clean, and counter to the intent of how the face-down cards are intended to work.
tags: Begin a Dance of Decades (Dances Up Earthquakes)

question: With Unnerving Pall (from Shroud of Silent Mist), when do you choose which Invaders are participating in the Ravage? When the card is played, or at the time of the Ravage? What if new damaged Invaders move in?
answer: At the time of the Ravage Step / Ravage Action. It's not clearly worded, but the Power is modifying the land, much like when Dahan get +Health in a particular land.

question: With Voice of Command, can Explorers take Damage from Towns/Cities? How does distributing damage work when you have a mixed group of Dahan and Explorers?
answer:
Yes, Explorers can take Damage. You can destroy Explorers before Dahan. (And will usually want to do so.)
You can also mix-and-match - destroy an Explorer or two, then deal damage to a Dahan - if for some reason you want to leave some Explorers alive.
